name: Cashaa
rootCause: Cashaa, a UK-based cryptocurrency exchange, said hackers stole 336 Bitcoins from a wallet on the exchange. The company has now stopped all transactions related to cryptocurrency.

descriptions.text: Cashaa, a UK-based cryptocurrency exchange, said hackers stole 336 Bitcoins from a wallet on the exchange. The company has now stopped all transactions related to cryptocurrency.

Cashaa's Bitcoin wallets were compromised in July 2020 when malware installed on an employee's personal computer enabled attackers to steal approximately 336 BTC. Operational security lapses allowed the attacker to access wallet credentials and transfer funds. An employee used a personal computer for OTC wallet management after reporting a malfunction with the company device. Malware installed on this machine allowed attackers to retrieve wallet credentials and sign unauthorized transactions, bypassing normal security, with no multi-signature enforced.
